Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

A nefarious plot to dominate the world lies hidden,

and the heroes are stepping up to resolve this global crisis!

 

We are introducing the February Update, celebrating the addition of the Marvel Studios’ Captain America: Brave New World inspired theme.

 

Falcon, who has inherited the title of Captain America and now has a Tier-4 update,

and Red Hulk, who has risen to the presidency of a nation, have received new Uniforms.

 

Joining the fray are Falcon (Joaquín Torres), the second Falcon who dominates aerial combat,

and Leader, whose exposure to gamma rays has given him unparalleled intelligence.

Both arrive in MARVEL Future Fight as Tier-3.

 

A new World Boss: Legend+ has also been added,

featuring the duo of Black Dwarf and Ebony Maw.

 

Various other improvements have been made to make the game more convenient to enjoy,

so please check the details below!

 

 

▣ Two New Heroes

 

Check out the abilities of Falcon (Joaquín Torres) <Marvel Studios' Captain America: Brave New World>, taking flight as the second Falcon, and Leader <Modern>, who has gamma-enhanced superintelligence.

* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

▣ Two New Uniforms

 

Two new Uniforms have been added in celebration of the Marvel Studios’ Captain America: Brave New World inspired Update.

Check out the abilities of Captain America (Sam Wilson) <Marvel Studios' Captain America: Brave New World>, and Red Hulk <Marvel Studios' Captain America: Brave New World>.

* The skill effects of the Uniform are based on the maximum skill level stats.

* The two new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <February Update Celebration Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

▣ Falcon Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added to Falcon.

He will showcase his abilities to prove himself as the new Leader.

* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Falcon (Joaquín Torres) and Leader Tier-3

 

Falcon (Joaquín Torres), who has taken flight to prove his worth, and Leader, driven by his insatiable thirst for knowledge, have received Tier-3 Ultimate Skills.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Red Hulk and Red She-Hulk Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Through the February Update, Red Hulk and Red She-Hulk

will acquire Potential Awakening & Transcendence!

* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ New World Boss: Legend+ <Black Dwarf & Maw> Release & World Boss Improvements

 

The Black Order’s formidable duo, Black Dwarf and Ebony Maw, known for their perfect balance of strength and intellect, are now featured as the third challenge in World Boss: Legend+ difficulty.

 

▶ World Boss: Legend+ <Black Dwarf & Maw> Release

 

1. Agents can challenge <Black Dwarf & Maw> from Difficulty 1 after clearing the unlock Challenges.

- Unlock Requirements:

Clear Story stage 8-3, Own three or more Tier-4 heroes, Clear all World Boss Challenges

- World Boss stages above every 10 levels are locked with specified Challenges, including those involving specific heroes.

 

 

 

2. Black Dwarf & Maw’s Conquer Level can be achieved up to 200, and the conquer effect can be upgraded along with acquiring Odin's Blessing Chest, Dimension Chest: C.T.P, and Tier-3 growth materials.

- The basic damage Black Dwarf & Maw receive increases as the Conquer Level increases.

- The Conquer Effect that applies to Black Dwarf & Maw has been added to the Corvus & Proxima’s Conquer Effect depending on their Conquer level.

 

 

 

3. Following Corvus & Proxima, Agents will have to face two bosses: Black Dwarf & Maw.

 

Overcome the cooperative patterns of the two bosses and earn rewards!

 

 

​- Depending on the progress, bosses will launch a powerful attack.

 

 

4. Clear Black Dwarf & Maw to acquire various rewards.

​- The Mighty C.T.P. of Energy, Regeneration, Destruction, Judgment, Authority, Greed, Refinement, and Insight can be acquired when clearing Black Dwarf & Maw.

-  Cosmic Cube Fragments can be acquired at a 100% rate from the World Boss: Legend+ difficulty.

- Agents can obtain a 'Special World Boss Loot' as the first clear reward when clearing each Floor from the 10th Floor and above.

- Agents can obtain the Emblem: Black Dwarf or Emblem: Ebony Maw as the first clear reward for every 10 Floors from the 50th Floor and above.

 

 

 

▶ World Boss Improvements

 

1. A Set Dealer feature has been added to the Select Characters screen in World Boss.

 

 

- The battle begins with the hero set as the dealer.

 

2. New acquisition sources for S.H.I.E.L.D. Archive items have been added.

- Items previously obtainable only in World Boss: Ultimate can now also be acquired in World Boss: Legend.

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Leader, Falcon (Joaquín Torres), Red Hulk, and Red She-Hulk have been added.

﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats. 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 

- Please note that the Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.

- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased.

The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.

- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.

- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end.

Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, one as an Otherworld Battle reward, and two more from the upcoming Event!

 

[February Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Marvel Studios’ Captain America: Brave New World theme.

Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Update Hot Deals & New Products

 

▶ ‘Update Hot Deals’ products have been added.

- Event Schedule:

After the 2/4 Maintenance - 3/4 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),

After the 2/4 Maintenance - 3/4 (Tue) 6:59 (PST)

- The products listed below are available for purchase under the Update Hot Deals category in the Store.

* The price is based on the Google Play Store.

 

 

 

 

▶ New Time Attack Special Products have been added.

- The special products below can be purchased if specific conditions are met.

- Certain Time Attack and pop-up products sold prior to the February update will be discontinued.

- The Time Attack product for returning Agents has been revamped and is available for a one-time purchase per account upon login after returning.

* The price is based on the Google Play Store.

 

1. New Starter products for Agents have been added.

 

 

2. A new Bonus Crystal product has been added.

 

 

3. The two products below are sold individually.

[A Chance of Tier-3 Mega Advancement / A Chance of Advanced Potential Transcendence]. 

The [Purchase All Tier-3 Advancement & Transcendence] allows you to purchase all two products above at once.

If you purchase one of the two individual packs first, you cannot purchase the [Purchase All Tier-3 Advancement & Transcendence].

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. The Normal Mode of Alliance Battle has been improved.

- You can now retry if you fail to clear the battle.

* Retrying consumes resources. (Retrying is unavailable once the battle is cleared.)

- The list of heroes used in recent battles will now be saved.

 

 

2. A filter for searching Artifacts has been added to the selection screen of the Artifact Selector.

- When selecting the higher-grade Artifact filter in the filter menu, the list is displayed based on the following criteria:
1) Artifacts not currently owned
2) Artifacts you own that are of the same or lower grade than the selector's grade

 

 

3. The purchase pop-up in the Dispatch / Uniform Shop now displays the resource information when purchasing items.

 

 

4. A button to increase points by +100 points has been added to the Agent Bonus screen.

 

 

5. In the X of Swords settings, under Bulk Enchant → Auto-Dismantle, you can now use the Check Equipped Sword menu to view the Equipped Sword Element Level.

 

 

6. Timeline Battle and Otherworld Battle have been improved to display victory and defeat information even when using the Power Saving Mode Theme.

 

7. Certain map names in Alliance Conquest have been updated.

- Slum → Harlem, Manhattan

 

8. The Epic Quests section in the Content Status Board has been refined to provide more detailed entry options.

- The Content Status Board save settings will reset after the maintenance.

Ex)

Before: Content Status Board →  The Big Twin (Epic Quest: X-Force)

After: Content Status Board → Cutting Cable, Ending the Stryfe (Epic Quest: X-Force)

 

9. The background modeling of [Timeline Survival - Snow Mountain, Antarctic, Siberia] have been improved.

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The issue where the league image was incorrectly displayed as 'Bronze 5' on the results screen after a Friendly Match in Otherworld Battle has been fixed.

 

2. The 5th Active Skill description in the Nick Fury <Marvel Studios' The Marvels> has been updated, changing [100% chance to grant All Damage Immunity (1 Sec.)] effects apply target from Self to All Allies.

* This was a display error, and the effect was correctly applied to all allies.

 

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
